name: secret-scrubber
description: Redacts API keys, tokens, passwords, .env values and private keys from tool output, subagent output and @-mentioned files before Claude reads them, and counts the redactions in the status line.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn secret redaction on or off.

configFile.title: Project config file
configFile.description: JSON file, relative to the project, whose keys override these options (enabled, showToast, disabledRules, patterns, patternsFile).

patternsFile.title: Extra patterns file
patternsFile.description: Optional JSON file with { "patterns": [{ "name", "pattern", "flags"?, "group"? }] } added to the built-in rules.

showToast.title: Toast on redaction
showToast.description: Show a toast naming what was redacted each time output is scrubbed (the status line count shows either way).
